title: Tame the 300°/s Knife Fight: Moza AB6 Setup for the MSFS Pitts S1S
description:
Dial in your Moza AB6 direct drive base for the Aviat Pitts Special S1S in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

With a roll rate exceeding 300° per second, the Biplane Class is a high-speed knife fight around the pylons. While pitch response is instantaneous, the biplane's high drag creates a lethal trap: yank back too hard on the stick and you generate a massive induced drag spike that instantly evaporates all your kinetic energy. In this guide, we configure in-game control assignments and fine-tune Moza Cockpit force feedback telemetry—using low damping, unlocked Z-axis twist, and a 95% stall buffet—so your hands feel maximum lift without bleeding a single knot of airspeed.

Want to skip manual slider adjustments? Download the ready-to-import profiles on the website:
🔗 Download FFB & Control Profiles: https://highintheflightsimsky.nl
